Banner.Description: I am a Fullstack Developer specializing in Spring Boot and Angular, with production experience building scalable backend APIs, responsive web apps, and native Kotlin Android apps. Proven in deploying secure cloud systems on AWS with automated CI/CD and robust Observability — looking to build and deploy high-performance applications.
AboutMe.Title: About Me
AboutMe.Paragraphs: I'm a Fullstack Developer specializing in building enterprise-grade backend systems using Spring Boot and dynamic, responsive frontends with Angular.
I have hands-on experience developing native mobile applications with Kotlin Android, creating seamless multi-platform experiences.
Additionally, during my internship, I gained practical experience developing backend services using Python, building efficient RESTful APIs and working with real-time systems.
I own the entire development lifecycle — from initial architecture and database design to containerization with Docker, automated CI/CD pipelines, and deployment on AWS.
I place a strong emphasis on system reliability, utilizing modern Observability tools to monitor, optimize, and scale production environments effectively.

Descriptions: Designed RESTful API endpoints, data schemas, and business logic for 3 core B2B modules (Vendors, Scope of Services, Country Requirements) on a live production platform used by external enterprise clients.
Increased API test coverage from 40% → 80% via pytest, eliminating regression bugs across 3 consecutive sprints before reaching production.

Take on client projects end-to-end — from requirements gathering to production deployment, covering both frontend and backend.
Integrate AI features into client products — including chatbots, recommendation logic, and ML model serving via API endpoints.

Project.Title: My Projects
Project.Label: Highlighted Project

Project.Projects.Title: SignConnect – Real-time Sign Language Recognition
Project.Projects.Description: Full-stack real-time sign language recognition system — FastAPI AI backend (BiLSTM model) + Next.js/MediaPipe frontend — enabling live subtitle generation during video calls with ~85% recognition accuracy. Shipped to 4 real users from hearing-impaired schools.

Project.Projects.Title: CalmSKIN – Skincare Microservices E-Commerce Platform
Project.Projects.Description: A production-grade skincare e-commerce platform built with a Spring Boot 3 microservices architecture and an Angular 21 + Tailwind CSS v4 front-end. Features a unique AI Face Scan Tool (Spring AI + Gemini API) for automated skin diagnostics, asynchronous message brokering via Apache Kafka, Redis caching, robust API gateway routing with JWT, and complete end-to-end telemetry (Micrometer, Zipkin, Prometheus, Grafana) containerized via Docker.

OtherProjects.Title: More Projects

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Online Ordering Food
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: A backend REST API for an online food ordering platform — handling menu management, ingredient customization, order processing, and order tracking, built entirely with Spring Boot.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: FastAPI CRUD engine
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: A reusable CRUD engine for FastAPI — automates REST endpoint generation with repository pattern, router scaffolding, filtering, pagination, and permissions. Supports advanced features like caching, rate limiting, webhooks, and audit hooks — significantly reducing boilerplate when building production APIs.
